items.title: Joe Temperley interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997
items.q: next year, the whole of February and March I’m going to be traveling with the Lincoln Center Jazz Orchestra with Wynton Marsalis.

ctx.x: Out of the work you do, how much of it involves going away from your home?

Well I mean I don’t travel around per se all the time. Like I’ve come out here, but I haven’t been on the road in two or three months. I do most of my work in New York. I do a lot of freelance work in New York and I work in various different places. I work with Junior Mance and we have a trio and sometimes a quartet. So when I do go traveling, it’s very pleasant. I do things like a trip on the Norway or this year we went to the festival in Berne, but it’s only like three or four days, it’s not a continuous thing.…
Quite an operation to move a whole orchestra like that.
